I've decided to undertake a major effort to improve the WoT wiki. I'm not a very literary writer, since I tend towards concise and factual statements from my career in business. But I am much better at picking out the names and otehr references from the books. A superior aid I have for this effort is full text of the books (at least through book 11 right now) that I scanned in, fixed up and divided up by chapter. That will allow me to carefully read the text, and highlight terms that should go into the wiki.

I'll also try some other things now and then, but I'm not very well versed in some update processes, especially footnotes. If I really feel the need I'll dig into this some more.

Hopefully, if I can keep up with a couple of chapters a day, I'll be close to finished by the time the last book comes out.
